instruction: Go to the Diamond Campground on recreation.gov, then open Chrome's bookmarks manager in a new tab.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent navigated to recreation.gov, searched for 'Diamond', clicked on Diamond Campground in Uinta-Wasatch-Cache National Forest (URL: recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233869). Then spent remaining turns scrolling through availability calendar and clicking 'Next Available' button repeatedly without producing the expected HTML content.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate Chrome to recreation.gov, use the site search box, click on autocomplete results, navigate to campground detail pages, scroll and interact with page elements
metadata.failure_analysis: Model got stuck in a loop clicking 'Next Available' and scrolling through the availability calendar for 50 turns. The evaluator expected specific HTML class content (camp-sortable-column-header) that the model never produced. The original task required interpreting and extracting specific calendar data, which was too complex.
metadata.task_rationale: Combines the successful navigation sub-task with opening a new tab. Tests multi-tab management alongside website navigation. Partial credit (0.5 each) for navigating to campground and opening bookmarks manager.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to Diamond Campground on recreation.gov and opening Chrome bookmarks manager in a new tab. Custom metric checks open tabs for both URL substrings with partial credit (0.5 per match).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter 'open_tabs_info' correctly extracts all open Chrome tab URLs and titles, which is exactly the state needed to verify both instruction requirements.
Custom metric correctly handles the 'expected' parameter - accesses 'expected.get("checks", [])' directly, which is correct since get_rule returns the rules dict.
URL substring check for Diamond Campground ('recreation.gov/camping/campgrounds/233869') is verified correct from trajectory data showing this is the actual campground URL.
URL substring check for Chrome bookmarks manager ('chrome://bookmarks') is the correct URL for the bookmarks manager tab.
Both instruction requirements (navigate to campground + open bookmarks manager) are fully covered with appropriate 0.5 weight each for partial credit.
Metric logic correctly iterates through all open tab URLs and checks for substring containment, handling both dict and string tab formats.
